behaviors.text: Each native node enrolls under its own identity (control registration).
Key lifecycle: node-key expiry is detected and the key is rotated.
The node receives network state (network-map updates) from the control plane.
Peer discovery, and addressing a peer by its real node identity.
NAT traversal for direct paths (STUN and disco).
Relay fallback (DERP) where a direct path fails.
Access policy from the control plane is applied (ACL/grants packet filter).
DNS naming reflects real node identity and lifecycle (MagicDNS), not host aliases.
Explicit behavior on token expiry, revoked access and a disconnected control plane.
Device clock uncertainty is not hidden when credential or certificate validation needs time.
Bounded relay buffers, peer counts, concurrent sessions and handshake rates.

tailscale-rs-0.6.1/workspace_edges.note: Intra-workspace edges only, plus the third-party closure from the pinned Cargo.lock (declared normal and build edges, every target and feature: an over-approximation). NOT a portability or OS-free claim; it comes from manifests and the lock alone, without building or running anything (the T01-X01 type-checks are separate evidence and show no OS-freedom).

native_requirement.study_outcome: No candidate is yet admitted for these fleet profiles. The official client is incompatible with the reported stock kernels (no PowerPC port; kernel floor above 2.6.35) and is not strict-Rust. tailscale-rs lacks NAT traversal, automatic key rotation and MagicDNS and is tokio/mio-bound (epoll_create1, above the reported PowerPC kernel). Its seven protocol-core crates and whole library now pass the pinned compile-only checks on both big-endian 32-bit musl targets. Those results do not establish linking, execution, stock-kernel compatibility or memory/CPU admission. The core crates have no intra-workspace runtime, OS or TLS edge, but their third-party closure still reaches libc through rand/getrandom and remains unqualified for this use. T01-X01 records those type-checks; T01-X02 and the required native feature remain blocked on measured client guest execution.
